results.quote: There is a randomized, augmenting paths-based algorithm that computes the maximum flow on a directed, uncapacitated graph in time \((m+nF)\cdot n^{o(1)}\), where \(F\) is the value of the maximum flow.
There is a randomized, augmenting paths-based algorithm that computes the maximum flow on a directed, uncapacitated graph in time \(mn^{1/2+o(1)}\).

results.bound: quality \(q=n^{o(1)}\log U\), amortized update time \(n^{o(1)}\log U\), Sparsifier\((\beta)\) time \(O(q\beta n\log U)\)
results.quote: There is a randomized dynamic sparsifier data structure with quality \(q=n^{o(1)}\log U\) such that each call to \(\mathrm{InsertArc}(e),\mathrm{DeleteArc}(e)\) is processed in amortized time \(n^{o(1)}\log U\), and each call to \(\mathrm{Sparsifier}(\beta)\) takes time \(O(q\beta n\log U)\).
